Description: In the Kitchen, Oswald talks with Harry Thornton in a probing exchange about the Chapel key and old family secrets. Eve Dauer briefly intervenes and brings up a past incident involving a corpse, abruptly tightening the tension.
Location: Kitchen（Kitchen）
Key Information:
  - Oswald enters the Kitchen and initiates conversation with Harry Thornton (No. 11), remarking that his demeanor resembles a butler Oswald knew in his youth.
  - Harry Thornton confirms that his father once served as butler in this house and says he is honored to take over the position.
  - A sound of a glass bottle shattering comes from upstairs, indicating a physical incident occurring simultaneously on the upper floor of the villa.
  - Eve Dauer joins the conversation and asks whether the upstairs noise has anything to do with Edmund Galley.
  - Oswald states clearly that he is looking for the key to the Chapel and suspects the key might be in Harry Thornton’s possession.
  - Harry Thornton denies having the Chapel key and offers to help search for it after dinner.
  - Prompted by Eve Dauer, the topic turns to “stories” about the Chapel; Harry Thornton admits he has heard related accounts from his father.
  - Harry Thornton confirms that his father once buried a woman and was also the one who discovered the body.
  - Eve Dauer directly states that “the one who found the body was his father,” pushing the conversation into a sensitive taboo.
  - Oswald immediately warns Eve Dauer not to discuss such matters in the house and tells both of them to keep silent about it going forward.
  - Oswald says he will wait until the others leave the Dining room before going to eat, and then leaves the Kitchen.
Characters:
  [Oswald（Oswald）] Person No. 3, an old resident closely tied to the Galley family history.
    · Searches for the Chapel key in the Kitchen and pressures Harry Thornton.
    · Actively references past family-and-servant history.
    · Shows clear vigilance and aversion toward stories involving a corpse.
  [Eve Dauer（Eve Dauer）] Person No. 10, Helen Dauer’s daughter.
    · Intervenes because of the noise from upstairs.
    · Directly mentions stories about the Chapel and the past discovery of a corpse.
    · Is immediately shut down by Oswald.
  [Harry Thornton（Harry Thornton）] Person No. 11, the current butler.
    · Confirms his father once served as butler here.
    · Denies holding the Chapel key and says he is willing to help search.
    · Admits he has heard about his father burying a body.
